summary: Our project, Interplanetary Survival Guide: Martian Map, is an interactive educational website designed to help people explore Mars and understand its environment using scientific data.We developed a platform featuring a 3D model of Mars, an interactive 2D map, and scientific information layers showing temperature, elevation, terrain, and dust storms. One of its main features is an astronaut navigation system. Users can select the astronaut’s starting location and destination on the map. The website then creates a route, displays waypoints, and simulates the astronaut’s movement across the Martian surface.Our project addresses the challenges of Mars exploration by demonstrating how astronauts could navigate unfamiliar terrain and understand environmental conditions. It makes complex scientific information easier to access and understand.This project is important because future human missions to Mars will require reliable navigation and knowledge of the planet. Our website combines science, technology, and interactive learning to make space exploration more engaging and accessible.Also the site consider the general information about the mars as temperature or features of mars. This is mean that all even simple people can use this site for developing general knowledge about Mars
details: Our project is an interactive educational website that helps users explore Mars and understand what is necessary for survival and navigation on the planet.The website includes a 3D model of Mars and an interactive 2D map. Users can explore different locations, study the planet’s surface, and view information about temperature, elevation, terrain features, and dust storms. One of the main features is an astronaut navigation system. Users can select a starting point and a destination on the map, create routes, and add waypoints to plan journeys across Mars.Our project makes scientific information easier to understand, encourages interactive learning, and demonstrates how technology could support future Mars exploration. Our goal is to show the challenges of exploring and living on another planet.We developed the website using GitHub and web technologies. For scientific research, we used real NASA studies, publications, scientific data, and materials, as well as geographical information about the Martian surface. This helped us make our project more reliable and based on real scientific evidence.Our project is creative because it combines scientific research, interactive maps, 3D visualization, and an astronaut navigation system in one platform. During development, our team considered scientific accuracy, user-friendliness, clear navigation, and the extreme environmental conditions on Mars.
